verdict.rationale: Installing GPU vendor drivers and building custom kernel modules is a fair question for a Linux desktop distribution, but the pack contains no first-party documentation of either: no driver installation path, no akmods/DKMS, and no kernel-module build tooling. The only on-topic community items are negative signals (Nvidia drivers called the 'biggest complaint', CUDA cited as a blocker). With no vendor claim to contradict, these support 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
